syncCliMcp.name: Auto-Generate MCP Configs for External Terminal CLI (Claude Code, OpenCode, etc.)
syncCliMcp.desc: Automatically generates config files (.claude/mcp.json, etc.) in your vault so CLI tools run in an external terminal can use Lumina's MCP tools (RAG, note tools). (Warning: Writes the MCP auth token in plaintext into vault config files—exclude them if syncing via Git/cloud. May also cause connection errors in your terminal when Obsidian is not running.)
syncCliMcp.confirmDesc:
Enabling this option writes the local MCP server's Bearer auth token in plaintext to config files in your vault (.claude/mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json, opencode.json, .codex/config.toml).
If your vault is synced or shared via Git, iCloud, or Obsidian Sync, the token may be exposed—please exclude these files in .gitignore.
Do you want to proceed?

generate_moc.desc: Generate a Map of Content (MOC) note that collects and links related notes. Use folder, tags, or files to define which notes to include.

replace_note.desc: Replace the entire content of an existing note.

patch_note.desc: Apply one or more text replacements to a note. Prefer using the patches array to batch multiple changes into a single tool call — this is more efficient and presents all changes to the user at once as a unified diff.

get_backlinks.desc: Get a list of notes that link to the specified note.

update_frontmatter.desc: Update a frontmatter property in a note.

get_note_metadata.desc: Get metadata (frontmatter, tags, creation date, etc) for a note.

list_attachments.desc: List all attachment files (images, pdfs) inside the vault, or linked in a note.

save_attachment.desc: Save a binary attachment file from base64 string.

run_shell_command.desc: Execute a terminal shell command on the desktop OS. Use with caution.

list_tags.desc: List all tags used in the vault.

create_canvas.desc: Create an Obsidian Canvas file (.canvas) with nodes and edges.

auto_link_note.desc: Automatically find unlinked mentions (note titles or aliases) in a note and replace them with internal markdown links ([[Title|Alias]]). CRITICAL: ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks to add backlinks or auto-link a note. NEVER try to manually read the note and use patch_note or replace_note to add links yourself, as it will crash the system.

query_metadata.desc: Query and filter vault notes by their frontmatter properties, tags, or folders. Returns a markdown table of the results. Use this tool when the user asks to list or aggregate notes based on their metadata (e.g. status, author, rating, dates).

show_notice.desc: Shows a notification message to the user.
show_notice.argMessage: The message to display in the notification.
show_notice.argDuration: Optional. The duration in milliseconds for the notice to be visible. (Default: 5000)

open_note.desc: Opens a note or file in the Obsidian editor workspace.

grep_search.desc: Searches for exact text or regex patterns across files in the vault. Returns matching lines with line numbers.

glob_files.desc: Finds files across the vault matching a glob pattern (e.g. "**/*.md", "Daily/*", "*.canvas").

list_folders.desc: Lists folders in the vault, optionally filtered under a specific parent folder.

get_outgoing_links.desc: Gets all outgoing links and embeds from a specific note, including target path and resolution status.

list_tasks.desc: Lists markdown task items (- [ ] / - [x]) across the vault or in a specific note, with optional completion filter.
